The '''BL-1T Riot Suppression Droid''' was a type of riot [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] used as security forces by the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. BL-1T Droids resembled other Selkath humanoid models, with [[Color/Legends|white]] plating and a blue sensor, and they used a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] in combat along with a powerful riot shield&mdash;which could be transferred to others&mdash;and a riot grappling cable. [[Sairisi]], the security chief at [[Genetics Laboratory G-1]], used two BL-1Ts, and they were destroyed when Sairisi was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a [[Operation on Manaan|covert raid]] on the facility.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Two BL-1T Riot Suppression Droids appear with Sairisi as the first boss in the Tactical Flashpoint "Depths of Manaan," which was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.9: Galactic Strongholds Early Access.<ref name="TOR" />
